articles.title: UP Cop’s Wife Alleges Illicit Affair with Woman Constable; Claims Beatings and Death Threats
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A woman residing in a society under the Bisrakh police station area of Greater Noida has levelled serious allegations against her husband, Neeraj Singh, a Sub-Inspector (SI) in the Uttar Pradesh Police.

body.html:
A woman residing in a society under the Bisrakh police station area of Greater Noida has levelled serious allegations against her husband, Neeraj Singh, a Sub-Inspector (SI) in the Uttar Pradesh Police. She has accused him of having an affair with a female constable, assaulting her after drinking, and even threatening to kill her.

Allegations of Affair and Assault
According to the complaint filed at Bisrakh police station, the woman stated that she discovered her husband’s alleged affair in June. Since then, she claims, Neeraj Singh has been frequently beating her under the influence of alcohol. The complainant further alleged that her husband often visits tourist destinations in Uttarakhand — including Haldwani, Mussoorie, and Haridwar — with the same female constable under the pretext of “official raids.”

The woman also claimed to possess incriminating photographs of her husband and the female constable as proof. She has sought protection for herself and her children, demanding strict legal action against both.

Police Initiate Inquiry
The allegations have caused a stir within the police department. Media cell in-charge Subodh Kumar stated that both Neeraj Singh and the female constable had earlier been suspended from Noida’s Sector-24 police station in separate cases. He confirmed that Neeraj Singh remains under suspension and both are currently absent without authorisation.

Kumar added that the department has taken the allegations seriously and launched a departmental inquiry. Further action will follow once the investigation concludes. The case has sparked concerns over the conduct and image of the police force, with expectations of a fair and transparent probe by senior officials.

articles.title: Angry Women Ransack Liquor Shop in Agra After Tragic Drowning Incident
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Tragedy in Agra: During Durga idol immersion in the Utangan river, 13 people drowned after slipping into a deep pit at an unauthorized spot — believed to be caused by illegal sand mining. Seven remain missing.

body.html:
Tragedy in Agra:
During Durga idol immersion in the Utangan river, 13 people drowned after slipping into a deep pit at an unauthorized spot — believed to be caused by illegal sand mining. Seven remain missing.

Angry villagers, grieving their loved ones, later stormed a liquor shop, smashing bottles worth lakhs in protest over delayed rescue efforts.

Rescue ops by NDRF, SDRF & Army continue. CM Yogi expressed grief.

articles.title: Husband Installs Secret Camera, Blackmails Wife Into Sleeping With Foreign Clients
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Bengaluru: A shocking case of harassment and exploitation has been reported from Puttenahalli, where a man allegedly blackmailed his wife using secretly recorded private videos and forced her to have physical relations with his foreign friends.

body.html:
Bengaluru: A shocking case of harassment and exploitation has been reported from Puttenahalli, where a man allegedly blackmailed his wife using secretly recorded private videos and forced her to have physical relations with his foreign friends.

According to the complaint filed at the Puttenahalli police station, the accused, identified as Syed Inamul Haque, had installed a hidden camera in the bedroom to record his wife’s private moments without her consent. He then allegedly shared these videos with friends abroad and threatened to leak them online if she refused to comply with his demands.

The victim also alleged that Haque deceived her into marriage despite already being married to another woman. She further accused him of physical assault, harassment, and forcing her into non-consensual acts by using the threat of leaking intimate visuals.

Based on her complaint, the Puttenahalli police have registered an FIR against Haque and three others. The accused is currently absconding, and a search operation is underway.

articles.title: Hapur Tragedy: Man Chased, Beaten by In-Laws, Dies After Alleged Poisoning
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Hapur, UP – A horrific incident has come to light in Uttar Pradesh’s Hapur, where a man was brutally assaulted by his in-laws and later died after allegedly being force-fed poison. The victim, identified as Sonu, had an argument with his wife on Wednesday morning.

body.html:
Hapur, UP – A horrific incident has come to light in Uttar Pradesh’s Hapur, where a man was brutally assaulted by his in-laws and later died after allegedly being force-fed poison.

The victim, identified as Sonu, had an argument with his wife on Wednesday morning. Following the quarrel, his wife called her family from Bulandshahr. Soon after, Sonu was allegedly attacked by his in-laws.

When Sonu tried to escape, CCTV footage captured the shocking chase: several men were seen running after him on the highway, one carrying a stick. Eyewitnesses said the attackers even misbehaved with passersby who tried to intervene.

Sonu was eventually caught, thrashed, and allegedly forced to drink poison. He was rushed to hospital in critical condition but died during treatment.

His mother, Sukhwiri, expressed anguish, saying,

“Couples fight, that is normal. I don’t know the reason behind their argument. My son gave his wife everything, even sold a bigha of land for her, while she took away my jewellery. They (in-laws) gave him something to drink and killed him.”

Based on the family’s complaint, a case has been registered against seven members of the wife’s family, including the wife herself. Police have begun a manhunt for the accused.

Station House Officer Pilkhuwa, Anita Chauhan, said,

“According to the initial investigation, Sonu consumed a poisonous substance and died during treatment. The matter is under investigation and legal action will be taken.”

The incident has sparked shock and anger in the area, with locals demanding strict action against the culprits.

articles.title: Chandauli Tragedy: Man Shoots Girlfriend Over Marriage Refusal, Ends Life
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Chandauli, UP – A shocking incident has shaken Chandauli district, where a young man shot his girlfriend after she refused to marry him, and later died by suicide.

body.html:
Chandauli, UP – A shocking incident has shaken Chandauli district, where a young man shot his girlfriend after she refused to marry him, and later died by suicide.

The accused, Sanjay Sonkar (25), a fruit vendor from Mahmudpur New Basti, was in a long-term relationship with Sabiya (Shadia) Bano (20/22), a resident of the same locality. However, when her family fixed her marriage elsewhere, she began distancing herself from him.

On Thursday evening, as Sabiya returned home with her mother carrying vegetables, Sanjay confronted her outside their house in Ramnagar. He reportedly asked if she would marry him. When she refused, he pulled out a pistol and shot her in the chest and stomach. She collapsed on the spot, critically injured, while locals rushed her to hospital.

After the shooting, Sanjay fled to his aunt’s house in Ramnagar, where he turned the gun on himself. He died on the spot.

Police, including SP Aditya Langhe and ASP Anant Chandrashekhar, reached the scene, recovered the pistol, and launched an investigation into the case.

Doctors have confirmed that the young woman remains in critical condition.

The shocking incident, rooted in a love affair opposed by family and rejection of marriage, has left the local community stunned.
